verdict.rationale: cubic's CLI explicitly 'finds bugs and generates a prompt that your coding agent can use to fix them' (cubic-docs-7), it auto-generates and pushes fixes directly to PR branches (cubic-docs-4), and an official MCP server lets agents read findings, request reviews, and triage issues (cubic-docs-8), backed by 'skills' instructions for agents (cubic-docs-17). Runtime probes confirm the CLI installs cleanly via npx and the MCP server is live and auth-gated (cubic-probe-rt-1, cubic-probe-rt-2). missing for 10: explicit naming/validation of specific agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) rather than generic 'coding agent' language, and independent hands-on confirmation of the fix-prompt handoff working end-to-end.
